text.tspan: Shared evidence and structured agent handoﬀs
Communication carries explicit claims, source records, modeling proposals, and unresolved choices.
Bond change, substrate structures, protein name + accession, sequence provenance
Native reaction, source passage, evidence status, contradictions and missing information
Reaction step, reactive atoms, cofactors, charges, assembly and proposed restraints
Admitted candidates separated from unresolved leads; source snapshots and revision
A discovery proposal is reviewed by the modeling agent before it becomes an executable setup.
Current schema-3.0 interface. Structural evidence import is implemented; source integrity does not establish claim correctness.
